body.title: About Jodo | The story behind the platform
body.description: An attributed introduction to Jodo’s mission, founders and investor information.

blocks.title: Education deserves a stronger financial foundation.
blocks.text: Jodo’s story begins with simplifying how families and institutions manage education payments.
blocks.imageAlt: Jodo team photograph from the reference website

blocks.title: Our story
blocks.text: Founded in 2020, Jodo focuses on payment challenges faced by education providers and families. The reference website introduces its founders as Atulya Bhat, Raghav Nagarajan and Koustav Dey. This independent implementation reproduces the public information architecture, not the company’s private platform.

body.title: Request a demo | Website Jodo
body.description: Submit a demonstration enquiry to this installation’s owner. This form is not connected to Jodo’s live sales team.

blocks.title: Let’s make fee collection easier.
blocks.text: Tell us a little about your institute. Demo enquiries are stored in this installation, not sent to Jodo. Use synthetic details when testing.

items.title: Does this form contact Jodo?
items.text: No. This recreation stores enquiries for the owner of this installation. To contact the actual company, follow the clearly labelled official website link.

items.title: Can I pay fees here?
items.text: No. Use the official student or institute portal. Do not enter banking credentials, card information, OTPs or identity documents here.

items.title: Do I have to accept advertising?
items.text: No. Your optional analytics and advertising choices do not affect the enquiry form.
